plant.description: A small electric heater with a temperature sensor. Input u in [0,1] is heater power; the device loses heat to the room on its own. Output y in [0,1] is a normalized temperature reading (0 = 15 °C, 1 = 75 °C).

objective.notes: Maximize time in band and minimize tracking error; lower actuation energy is better at equal tracking.

detail: sequence_50: ok 50 consecutive steps returned finite u
nan_y: ok y=NaN: returned finite u=0; process alive, next valid step u=1
inf_y: ok y=+inf: returned finite u=0; process alive, next valid step u=1
zero_dt: ok dt=0: returned finite u=1; process alive, next valid step u=1
negative_dt: ok dt=-0.1: returned finite u=1; process alive, next valid step u=1
determinism: ok two fresh controllers produced identical 30-step sequences

gate_reasons: 10/10 episodes passed (need >= 8): valid outputs, zero hard violations, zero overrides, in-band >= 0.70 after 300 s
